# PlayerDimensionChangeSource Enumeration

> [!CAUTION]
> This enum is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Describes what caused a player to change dimensions. Sent as part of [*@minecraft/server.PlayerDimensionChangeAfterEvent*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/server/PlayerDimensionChangeAfterEvent.md).

## Constants
### **PlayerRespawn**
`PlayerRespawn = "PlayerRespawn"`

The player respawned in another dimension after dying.
### **Portal**
`Portal = "Portal"`

The player changed dimensions through a portal.
### **TeleportCommand**
`TeleportCommand = "TeleportCommand"`

The player was teleported to another dimension by a command, such as /tp or /execute, or by a script teleport.
### **Unknown**
`Unknown = "Unknown"`

The cause of the dimension change is not known.
